fields.summary: 500 and stacktrace with empty path element

comments.body: justin, what is the scenario here? GET? PUT? something else?

curl -X HEAD -i http://fedoraAdmin:fedoraAdmin@localhost:8983/fedora/rest/test/me/mb/er/s//members/9528a300-22da-40f2-bf3c-5b345d71affb
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: text/html;charset=ISO-8859-1
Cache-Control: must-revalidate,no-cache,no-store
Content-Length: 1462
Hang on-- do we just want to elide that empty segment? That seems a bit more friendly. Would that be too inexact and cause problems later...?

In general, we have taken the position of not modifying user requests. justin submitted this issue and seems to be expecting a client error status.
Thoughts, A. Soroka? justin?
Yeah, I think you're right. I just wanted to throw the idea out. But playing it conservatively is the right thing to do here.
